references.text: The prophecy of the Messiah who would suffer for humanity's sins, which is reflected in Jesus' scourging before crucifixion.
David's prophetic description of the circumstances surrounding the crucifixion, which includes suffering.
Jesus predicts his own suffering and death, including being handed over to be scourged and crucified.
Pilate yields to the crowd's demands and has Jesus scourged before crucifixion, parallel to the event in Matthew.
Luke's description of Pilate yielding to the crowd and releasing Barabbas, while Jesus is scourged and handed over to be crucified.
John describes how Pilate had Jesus scourged, in line with the events described in Matthew.
